info.title: Qovia API
info.summary: Public web data API for AI: 164 endpoints, one key, one JSON envelope.
info.description:
Public web data for AI agents and developers: social, e-commerce and web platforms behind one API key and one JSON envelope.

- **Base URL:** `https://api.qovia.ai`
- **Auth:** `Authorization: Bearer <API key>` (or `x-api-key: <API key>`). Create keys at https://qovia.ai/console/?tab=keys.
- **Requests:** GET endpoints take query parameters, POST endpoints a JSON object body. Unknown parameters are rejected with 400 `invalid_params`.
- **Responses:** HTTP 200 with `{"request_id", "data", "meta"}`. An empty result is still 200, with `meta.empty: true` and `data` empty or null. Errors are `{"error": {"code", "message", "request_id", "support"}}`; branch on `code`.
- **Billing (USD):** a new account gets 50 trial calls on any endpoint (`meta.trial_calls_remaining` counts down); after that, a prepaid balance. Only successful, non-empty results are charged or counted, and errors and empty results are not.
- **Rate limits:** 60 requests per minute per account (600 after the first top-up); some endpoints also have a global per-second cap (429 `endpoint_busy`). Honour `Retry-After`.
- `/v1` only takes GET and POST: other methods (e.g. PUT, DELETE) get a framework 405 `{"detail": "Method Not Allowed"}`, and an unexpected server error may be a plain-text 500. Neither is charged.

Docs: https://qovia.ai/docs/ · API reference: https://qovia.ai/docs/api-reference/ · Chinese: https://qovia.ai/zh/docs/

get.description: Xingtu creator profile: nickname, followers, gender, location, the matching Douyin uid / sec_uid / handle, MCN, content labels, Xingtu and e-commerce status. Unknown author ids answer 404 and are not charged.

get.description: Reach overview for the last 30 or 90 days: video count, average likes/comments/shares, interaction rate, completion rate, median plays and the share of peers beaten, plus CPM/CPE estimates. Rates are Xingtu's basis-point integers (528 = 5.28%); expect_cpm, expect_cpe and sales_expect_cpm are in CNY cents. A window without videos answers empty (estimates only) and is not charged.

200.description: Success. Charged only when data is non-empty.

get.x-qovia-title-zh: 抖音星图视频批量指标
get.x-qovia-description-zh: 一次查询最多 20 个抖音视频的标题、发布时间、时长、播放、点赞、评论、分享、收藏和互动率。返回顺序不保证与 请求一致，查不到的 ID 直接缺席；按次计费，全部查不到时返回空结果，不计费。

get.summary: Douyin Xingtu creator search lift V2
get.description: Xingtu's search lift for a creator, returned as Xingtu answers: the average searches after viewing personal_avg_search_after_view_cnt with its peer percentile personal_avg_search_after_view_cnt_rank_percent, the search-after-view rate personal_avg_search_after_view_rate and the search-term CTR personal_search_word_ctr, plus modify_time and base_resp. Xingtu only publishes display values (such as "100 - 1,000" or "<0.02%"), returned as strings; the window is Xingtu's default and cannot be chosen. Fast: usually about 2 seconds. A creator without data (those fields missing, or only base_resp) answers empty. Only an answer with data is charged; an empty answer or an error is not.

200.description: Success. Charged only when data is non-empty.

get.x-qovia-title-zh: 抖音星图达人种草价值 V2
get.x-qovia-description-zh: 星图给出的达人种草价值（原样 JSON）：看过达人视频后的平均搜索次数 personal_avg_search_after_view_cnt 及同类排名百分位 personal_avg_search_after_view_cnt_rank_percent、看后搜索率 personal_avg_search_after_view_rate、搜索词点击率 personal_search_word_ctr，以及 modify_time、base_resp。 星图只给展示值（如"100 - 1,000"、"<0.02%"），按字符串原样输出；统计窗口为星图的默认窗口，不可选。响应较快，通常约 2 秒。 没有数据（缺少这些字段或只有 base_resp）时返回空结果。只对有数据的结果计费，空结果和出错都不计费。

get.summary: Douyin Xingtu creator homepage videos V3
get.description: The video list on a Xingtu creator's homepage, returned as Xingtu answers: each entry in items holds item_id, video_id, title, create_time, duration, plays watch_cnt, likes like_cnt, comments comment_cnt, interact_rate, finish_rate, content_theme_labels, cover and link, plus pagination (page, limit, total_count, has_more) and base_resp. Optional page (default 1; continue while has_more is true). Fast: usually about 3 seconds. A creator without videos (items missing or empty, or only base_resp) answers empty. Only an answer with data is charged; an empty answer or an error is not.

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Page number, 1 for the first page

200.description: Success. Charged only when data is non-empty.

A SKU without reviews, or one that does not exist, answers empty and is not charged.

get.x-qovia-title-zh: 京东商品评价
get.x-qovia-description-zh: 京东商品的买家评价，从新到旧，每页 10 条：评价内容和时间、1–5 星评分、规格和 SKU ID、买家昵称（多数已由京东打码）、匿名标记、IP 属地、晒图（原图）、有用数和商家回复。 默认只看这个 SKU 的评价，only_this_sku 为 false 时返回同一商品所有规格的评价。 可翻页数见 max_page（常远少于评价总数），has_more 为 false 时停止。没有评价或 SKU 不存在时返回空结果，不计费。
